mapper.select: SELECT FROM order_request WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND request_id=#{requestId}
SELECT FROM order_request WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE NOWAIT
SELECT FROM order_request WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE order_request SET status='PROCESSING',lease_owner=#{owner},lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{leaseSeconds},UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), last_error=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND request_id=#{requestId} AND (status='RETRY' OR (status='PROCESSING' AND lease_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)))

UPDATE order_request SET status='CREATED',amount=#{amount},lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,last_error=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND request_id=#{requestId} AND status='PROCESSING' AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE order_request SET status='RETRY',lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,last_error='ORDER_BUILD_FAILED',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND request_id=#{requestId} AND status='PROCESSING' AND lease_owner=#{owner}
